articles.title: These clues might point to life on other worlds
articles.snippet: Gases and color on distant planets may trace to activity by extraterrestrial life. If so, those E.T.s are likely tiny, one-celled beings.

articles.title: Some germs ride a superhighway at the edge of space
articles.snippet: Some microbes common on Earth’s surface lead a secret double life. Soaring higher than jumbo jets, they carry clues about disease spread and alien life.

articles.title: Physicists may have finally glimpsed elusive dark matter
articles.snippet: For decades scientists have been trying to detect this invisible substance that fills the cosmos. The LZ experiment may have finally spied it.
